english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Medium of instruction and assessment is English (`#page=2`), with no special preparatory language courses prior to exchange (`#page=3`); no separate standardized test score cutoff published in the fact sheet. RHET 1020 waiver not stated.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: No special language courses stated on #page=3; MoU partner nomination portal at https://international.iitd.ac.in/.

host_language_requirement.value: Not required; instruction and assessment are in English and no pre-term language courses are offered (`#page=2–3`).

fall_term_dates.value: 2026-07-23 to 2026-11-25 (AY 2026-27 Semester I: reporting/orientation Jul 18–23; classes start Jul 23/27; mid-sem Sep 12–18; end-sem exams Nov 19–25, 2026)

spring_term_dates.value: 2027-01-01 to 2027-05 (AY 2026-27 Semester II: registration Jan 1, 2027; classes commence Jan 4, 2027; mid-sem Feb 22–27, 2027; semester end date TBA)

tuition_model.notes: Student exchanges operate strictly through active institutional MoUs (https://international.iitd.ac.in/); neither the undated local fact sheet nor non-mirror iitd.ac.in pages explicitly state incoming exchange tuition waiver terms without consulting the MoU.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory personal comprehensive health insurance for the full stay (copy submitted upon joining). Regular BHM hostel/mess charges (`hostel-charges.pdf`): INR 7,000 non-refundable allotment + INR 15,000 refundable deposit; mess ~INR 38,580–52,980/semester + ~INR 8,600/semester seat rent.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Technology- Delhi (IIT- Delhi)/Indian Institute of Technology- Delhi (IIT- Delhi).pdf#page=3

housing_availability.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Technology- Delhi (IIT- Delhi)/Indian Institute of Technology- Delhi (IIT- Delhi).pdf#page=3
housing_availability.notes: On-campus hostel accommodation available for exchange students subject to prior confirmation.

housing_notes.value: On-campus hostel accommodation available for incoming exchange students (`#page=3`); BHM hostel/mess charges on `hostel-charges.pdf` list mess ~INR 38,580–52,980/sem, seat rent ~INR 8,600/sem, plus one-time INR 7,000 allotment and INR 15,000 refundable security deposit.
housing_notes.notes: Exchange hostel availability confirmed on data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Technology- Delhi (IIT- Delhi)/Indian Institute of Technology- Delhi (IIT- Delhi).pdf#page=3.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Incoming exchange students must obtain an Indian Student Visa from the Indian Embassy prior to arrival and are strictly prohibited from working (paid or unpaid) (`#page=3`). Stays >180 days require FRRO Delhi registration within 14 days via https://indianfrro.gov.in/efrro.
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.source_ref: data/raw/factsheets/Indian Institute of Technology- Delhi (IIT- Delhi)/Indian Institute of Technology- Delhi (IIT- Delhi).pdf#page=3
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: FRRO portal and 14-day rule also referenced on https://international.iitd.ac.in/.

credit_system_and_load.value: Credit-based L-T-P (Lecture-Tutorial-Practical) system graded on a 10-point scale with mid-semester and end-semester evaluations.

course_restrictions_note.value: Inter-departmental courses are allowed subject to approval by the course advisor; per-semester available courses can be provided on request (`#page=2`).

international_support_services.value: Airport pick-up service available once confirmed (`#page=3`); UG (`drugs@admin.iitd.ac.in`) and PG (`drgpsr@admin.iitd.ac.in`) administrative sections (`#page=1`), plus FRRO registration guidance.
